answer: Each agent must crack a walnut: the beacon emits a pulse each epoch, and the agent must anchor a unique hash chain. The first link costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent link doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at link 14 (20.4 M iterations). An anchor audit verifies each link against the epoch pulse; any broken link voids the chain. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full chain cost because each link binds to the unique identity key—no work sharing possible.
